crossRefs.note: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I…
What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
where then is my hope? as for my hope, who will see it?
As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions…
I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”
Then he said to me, “Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Behold, they say, ‘Our bones are dried up…

translations.web: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from Yahweh.”
translations.bsb: So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”
translations.kjv: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
translations.asv: And I said, My strength is perished, and mine expectation from Jehovah.
